title: MONSOON DUEL: Epic Sword Fight Music in the Rain (original score)
description:
Two warriors, one storm. Rain hammers the blades, the world freezes between two drops, then the storm breaks. An epic hybrid score of orchestra, synths and cinematic guitar, with a lead that bends and sings like a voice.

For fans of epic battle music, sword fight scores, trailer music and workout or gaming hype. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Monsoon Duel (Global cut), an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
